title: LinguoMT: Benchmarking Multilingual Speech Translation for Low-Resource African Languages

paper_title.description: Full paper title as it appears in the publication

authors.description: First author + et al., e.g. 'Barrault et al.'

model.description: Exact model name and size used for evaluation

language.description: Display language name matching our system output (e.g. 'Yoruba')

metric.description: One of: BLEU, spBLEU, ChrF, WER, CER

score.description: Numeric score — must be a number, not empty

citation_key.description: Citation key matching an entry in references.yaml

notes.description: Evaluation split, conditions, or caveats (e.g. 'Official FLEURS test set')

reference_fields._comment: Schema for entries in references.yaml. The framework validates each entry against these fields and warns on violations — validation never blocks model training.

citation_key.description: Unique identifier for this reference entry, e.g. 'barrault2023seamlessm4t_yoruba'

author.description: Full author list as a single string, e.g. 'Smith, Jane and Jones, Bob and others'

model.description: Exact model name and variant, e.g. 'SeamlessM4T-v2-large'

datasets.description: List of dataset names the paper evaluates on, e.g. [FLEURS, Flores-200]

language.description: Target language name, e.g. 'Yoruba'. One entry per language.

directions.description: List of task directions the paper reports, e.g. ['Source → English', 'ASR']

metrics.description: List of reported metrics, e.g. [BLEU, WER]. 'score' corresponds to metrics[0].

score.description: Numeric score for metrics[0]. Set to null if not yet filled — excluded from comparison tables.

summary.description: 2–5 sentences: (1) what the paper does, (2) which languages/datasets/metrics it covers, (3) why it is relevant as a comparator.

booktitle.description: Conference or workshop proceedings name (for type: inproceedings)

url.description: URL to the paper (arXiv or official venue)

notes.description: Caveats, where to find the score, or dataset/split differences vs our evaluation.
